semantics: A complete-H2D-P90-covering subset is not the number of all potentially useful partial-overlap opportunities.
Starting 100ms before a boundary can reduce demand-path exposed recovery only if useful data/dependencies advance and extra control, contention or residence does not offset that progress.
Observed per-event maximum planned FULL sums may share or revisit physical pages and are not unique transferable bytes or an oracle ceiling.
Residual FULL Host hits are native cache-accounting byte proxies at the next request, not proof that all of them were safely Host-only or prefetchable before the boundary.
Per-reason event groups overlap and their residual byte proxies must not be added.
The profile records exclusive function wall intervals, not pure logging overhead, full CPU utilization, GPU stall or removable JCT.
Background writing does not eliminate synchronous snapshot construction or possible CPU/GIL contention.
Later formal runs may reduce diagnostics using matched minimal common observation and separate diagnostic pairs; keep required causal inputs, physical dependency handling and outcome attribution.
